candidates.source_title: How the First Combat Submarine Actually Worked #engineering #history #submarine
candidates.source_description:
See how a Confederate submarine sank a Union warship during the American Civil War using a hand-cranked propulsion system.

We analyze the engineering of this cramped iron vessel, which relied on eight sailors turning a long crank to move underwater. The commander navigated by candlelight while the crew operated in silence, eventually ramming the enemy vessel with a bomb attached to a long pole. This breakdown examines how the craft functioned and why it failed to return from its mission.

By lo
